operational_failure.diagnosis: The guard detects a durable delta only by the ABSENCE of a clean tree. Run 38792663259 committed its own work (its snapshot HEAD is the producer's own commit 72ecb19, message 'Frontier frontier-adversarial-discoverability v1 run 38792663259: ...'), so the working tree was clean at the guard, all three conditions held, and the step exited 67. The work was already durable and complete; the guard, not the producer, failed. The resilience job then correctly dispatched this operational resume from the snapshot branch cycle/frontier/frontier-adversarial-discoverability/38792663259/team.
operational_failure.failing_step: Validate Frontier producer delta and state
operational_failure.guard_shell: if git diff --quiet && git diff --cached --quiet && [[ -z "$(git status --porcelain -uall)" ]]; then echo '::error::Frontier producer returned success with zero durable delta'; exit 67; fi
rejected_alternatives: exit 68 (missing state file) / exit 69 (state not advanced past INITIALIZED): the state file exists and satisfies every jq condition.
Enforce team scope exit 4: the snapshot contains no path outside this team's five prefixes.
Job timeout: the Persist team snapshot step runs with if: always() and the snapshot branch exists, so the job reached the end of its step list.
operational_failure.remediation_applied: This run leaves its delta in the working tree UNCOMMITTED, which is what the guard inspects; the workflow's own 'Persist team snapshot' step (if: always()) commits it into the snapshot. Committing here would have reproduced the same exit 67 and an infinite resume loop.
operational_failure.reproduction: Replaying the guard verbatim in the resumed checkout, with the same clean tree the producer left, prints '::error::Frontier producer returned success with zero durable delta' and trips exit 67. The state checks in the same step pass (charter_version==1, cycle_status!=INITIALIZED, evidence_tier non-empty), so exit 68/69 were not the cause.
operational_failure.residual_risk: The guard is a workflow-level false negative: any producer that commits its own work is failed after the fact. This team cannot change .github/ (forbidden by the charter's write scope), so the finding is handed to the factory owner in reports/frontier/frontier-adversarial-discoverability/OPERATIONAL_RESUME_CYCLE_38794235870.md rather than patched.
